scope.source: Official emulator automatically retained hilog_tmp_* gzip files

record.identity_evidence: Binary record prefix contains com.example.piliplus/XComFlutterOHOS_Native and two little-endian u32 values 3582 at offsets -149/-145 from the exception text.
record.message: Native loading opacity update failed: MissingPluginException(No implementation found for method setOpacity on channel piliplus/native-loading/22)

source_reconstructed_call_chain: native_loading_opacity.dart:38-40 onError catches the failure and writes the observed diagnostic

interpretation.hypothesis: OhosView key changes for color/animate can unregister an old platform-view handler before the replacement view callback attaches its new channel; an opacity animation may still address the old per-view channel during that gap. Whole-widget disposal can also race an already in-flight call.
interpretation.hypothesis_evidence: harmony_loading.dart uses ValueKey((color, animate)) at line 116 and attaches the replacement channel at line 130; native view dispose unregisters its handler. No runtime stack or explicit disposal-event pairing proves the exact trigger.
